data.title: Banking demo - incident triage
data.description: Error logs by service, exceptions by service.version, slow database spans and a service.version breakdown for the banking-demo environment (OTel-native logs-*.otel-* and traces-*.otel-*). Managed as code.

config.content:
## Banking demo - incident triage
Start with error logs and exceptions, then check `service.version` (bad release `2.0.0`) and slow database spans (`accounts-ledger` slow-db fault).

data_source.query: FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE deployment.environment == "banking-demo" AND severity_number >= 17 | STATS error_logs = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service.name

FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE deployment.environment == "banking-demo" AND exception.type IS NOT NULL | STATS occurrences = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY service.name, service.version, exception.type | SORT occurrences DESC | LIMIT 25

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS transactions = COUNT(*), p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(transaction.duration.us, 95) / 1000.0, 1), failures = SUM(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0)) BY service.name, service.version | EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(100.0 * failures / transactions, 2) | KEEP service.name, service.version, transactions, p95_ms, error_rate_pct | SORT service.name, service.version

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | EVAL service_version = CONCAT(service.name, "@", service.version) | STATS failures = SUM(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0)), total = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service_version | EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(100.0 * failures / total, 2) | KEEP bucket, service_version, error_rate_pct

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "span" AND span.type == "db" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000.0 BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service.name

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "span" AND span.type == "db" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS spans = COUNT(*), p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000.0, 1), max_ms = ROUND(MAX(span.duration.us) / 1000.0, 1) BY service.name, span_name = name | SORT p95_ms DESC | LIMIT 20
